scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 76 boards from four live Deity 6p Continents Online games of 2026-11-18 whose trade capacity stood at one until turn 119 or later (civvis-20261118T045850Z Kongo Science, -T051842Z Canada, -T053007Z Sumeria and -T061033Z Hungary Diplomatic), every fifth turn from t60 to t150, each the run's events.jsonl cut after turn N+1 and replayed at turn N. Both arms run one frozen ci-profile civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch at c1c46c02a2 with the run's own requested genome (why.log line 1 forced); the on arm adds --with trade-district-follows-the-campus. 76 boards completed in both arms. Orders differ on 31 of them (by run: civvis-20261118T045850Z 9 of 19; civvis-20261118T051842Z 8 of 19; civvis-20261118T053007Z 7 of 19; civvis-20261118T061033Z 7 of 19); the on arms journal 40 'trade-district-follows-the-campus:' claim lines (14 Market, 13 Lighthouse, 10 Commercial Hub, 3 Harbor) and the off arms 0. 28 of the claims end the frame as the city's production order. The other 12 lose the queue later in the same frame (those on arms replayed with their journals): near-done-work-finishes hands 9 back to a head within two turns of done, which the claimed item then follows; sea-scout-claims-the-queue takes 2 for a Caravel; a Spy order takes 1. Production orders for a Commercial Hub, Harbor, Market or Lighthouse number 25 in the off arms and 51 in the on arms. The 24 boards at t60-t85 read identical in every run.
